# Ada Quillen

Ada Quillen leads design at Fenwick Labs. She owns the brand refresh, the quarterly style review and the vendor shortlist. Prefers a short written update on Mondays and a call only when something is blocked. Her team works across two time zones, so decisions are written down the same day. Open question: who signs off on the new logo files before they go to the printer? Last spring she ran the packaging review with the print vendor, kept the notes in the shared folder, and asked that every proof be checked against the brand colours before it was approved. She is on leave in August; Ben covers the approvals until she is back.
